HomePage.title: Welcome to our website
HomePage.description: This is a Next.js application translated into Bangla and English.

aboutUs.title: Meet the team empowering change
aboutUs.subtitle: Behind MPowerHer is a passionate team working across education, outreach, translation, social media, and fundraising to make menstrual health information and resources more accessible.
aboutUs.teamDescription: Every member brings a different perspective, skill, and reason for being part of MPowerHer. Explore their stories and the motivation behind their work.
aboutUs.noResultsDescription: Try changing your search or selecting another team category.
aboutUs.closingDescription: Together, the MPowerHer team is working to make menstrual health education, awareness, and resources more accessible.

aparnaPrasad.name: Aparna Prasad
aparnaPrasad.bio: I joined MPowerHer to channel my enthusiasm for health and education toward striving for a world where all girls feel positive and confident about themselves.

rachelDsouza.name: Rachel Dsouza
rachelDsouza.bio: MpowerHer felt like an amazing opportunity to help others, especially girls like me. Being a part of this organization allowed me to contribute to its impact, and uplift women on an international scale!

kahoSuzuki.name: Kaho Suzuki
kahoSuzuki.bio: I wanted to help with MpowerHer because I wanted to help create engaging health lessons that make important information accessible and easy to understand.

lailaGhoneim.name: Laila Ghoneim
lailaGhoneim.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I'm passionate about education and wanted to help girls learn more about their health and well-being.

meeraArun.name: Meera Arun
meeraArun.bio: Mpowerher drew me in because I wanted to connect with others and help spread awareness about menstrual health and period poverty.

inarahRahman.name: Inarah Rahman
inarahRahman.bio: I wanted to join MpowerHer because I wanted to advocate for girls' health and help bring attention to the challenges of period poverty.

areebaMahbub.name: Areeba Mahbub
areebaMahbub.bio: I'm helping out with MpowerHer because I wanted to make important health information accessible to girls across different languages and communities.

rifayaFaial.name: Rifaya Faial
rifayaFaial.bio: I joined MpowerHer to help break down language barriers and make menstrual health education more accessible.

simrahAhmed.name: Simrah Ahmed
simrahAhmed.bio: Mpowerher is so great because I believe everyone deserves access to information about their health in a language they can understand and this program does just that.

zainaKhan.name: Zaina Khan
zainaKhan.bio: I founded MpowerHer because I wanted to help combat period poverty and make menstrual health education and resources more accessible to girls who need them.

namiraNadeem.name: Namira Nadeem
namiraNadeem.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I wanted to use social media to educate others and raise awareness about menstrual health.

zoeBruce.name: Zoë Bruce
zoeBruce.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I wanted to use my creativity to advocate for women's health and help spread awareness about period poverty.

deeshaRoopesh.name: Deesha Roopesh
deeshaRoopesh.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I wanted to help combat period poverty and raise the resources needed to make a real difference.

liliPerkins.name: Lili Perkins
liliPerkins.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I wanted to contribute to a cause I care about and help provide girls with the resources they deserve.

rethikaSathymathen.name: Rethika Sathymathen
rethikaSathymathen.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I believe period poverty should never keep a girl from learning, participating, or feeling confident in her daily life.

aidaKarim.name: Aida Karim
aidaKarim.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I wanted to support girls in underserved communities and help make conversations about menstrual health more accessible.

norahChowdhury.name: Norah Chowdhury
norahChowdhury.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I wanted to create meaningful content that helps people understand and care about menstrual health.

hafsahKhaja.name: Hafsah Khaja
hafsahKhaja.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I wanted to connect people with important resources and advocate for better health education for girls.

navyaPasumarthi.name: Navya Pasumarthi
navyaPasumarthi.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I wanted to use social media to educate, inspire, and bring more attention to menstrual health and period equity.

krupaKuber.name: Krupa Kuber
krupaKuber.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I wanted to turn my passion for this cause into action by helping raise funds for menstrual products and health resources.

tasheenKashem.name: Tasheen Kashem
tasheenKashem.bio: I joined MpowerHer because I wanted to help raise both awareness and funds to improve access to menstrual health resources.
